dark.$comment: Gap 1 — dark-mode surface inversions. Strategy: option 1 from README (light stroke on dark ground) for functional UI; option 2 (dark ink on light paper) is for hand-drawn assets and is not tokenized here (asset-level concern).

card.comment: Dark counterpart to surface.card (#424242) — lighter than page so cards read as elevated

scrim.comment: Overlay scrim behind modals and the mobile sidebar. Mode-agnostic on purpose: the job is to darken whatever sits behind it, and a lighter scrim in dark mode would weaken the panel's separation from the page rather than strengthen it. Value is the literal AspSidebar had hardcoded before AspModal needed the same wash.

dark.$comment: Gap 1 continued — dark-mode text inversions. NOTE: muted has no dark override by design as of Task-#2418 -- it derives from currentColor and is theme-agnostic. Re-adding a literal dark value would silently reintroduce the surface-polarity bug.

body.comment: Ambient body ink, dark theme. Note there is deliberately NO dark override for on-fixed-light: brand amber is light in both themes, so its ink must not flip. Task-#2417.

on-light.comment: In dark mode this maps to text-on-dark-surface

primary-50.comment: Gap 2 — semantic ramps for brand.primary (amber). Derived via HSL lightness steps from #ffb300 (H=42°, S=100%).

primary-900.comment: Equals color.brand.primary-hover; keeps existing hover semantics

chart.$comment: Gap 3 / §3.78 item 2 (#4187) — 10-color categorical chart palette, SURFACE-RESOLVED. A single flat set cannot clear the 3:1 non-text floor on both a light page (#e4e4e4) and a dark card (#424242) — the two sanctioned worst cases are disjoint (design_agent ruling on #4175). So the CHARTS select between two derived sets by the resolved background's luminance in AspChart.palette()/AspBarChart (NOT the page theme): `series-*-on-light` (darkened, >=3.2:1 vs #e4e4e4) and `series-*-on-dark` (>=3.2:1 vs #424242, the tightest dark surface, and clears #1a1a1a/#2a2a2a). Both re-checked color-blind-safe (CIEDE2000 + Machado-2009 sim): on-light min dE00 3.502, on-dark 3.363 (= the Okabe-Ito base bar). See docs/chart-series-cvd-4187.md. The bare `series-*` set is LEFT UNCHANGED as the Okabe-Ito base — it is ALSO consumed by AspContent's syntax-highlight ramp against the code surface (AspContent.vue:527/541), which is a different surface with its own cleared AA; darkening it would regress that ramp (found via content.spec). Base hues preserved per family; s1 stays amber (brand).

series-8.comment: Okabe-Ito orange (distinct from brand amber under color-blind simulation)

series-10.comment: Brand accent (soft blue) — for continuity with links

series-1-on-light.comment: Brand amber, darkened for the light chart surface #e4e4e4

series-8-on-light.comment: Okabe-Ito orange, darkened + hue-nudged off amber (s1) to hold dE00 under deuteranopia

series-1-on-dark.comment: Brand amber — dark-surface set (drawn on --surface-card #424242 / --surface-page dark)

series-2-on-dark.comment: Okabe-Ito blue, lightened for the dark surface

series-8-on-dark.comment: Okabe-Ito orange (distinct from brand amber under color-blind simulation)

warning.comment: Gap 8 — amber-orange warning, distinct from brand.primary (#ffb300) so warning is unambiguously alarming rather than branded

dark.$comment: Task-#1970 audit — dark-mode overrides for the -text variants defined in base.json under color.feedback.*-text. Alpha-tinted -bg values are mode-agnostic and do not need dark overrides. Emitted under [data-theme='dark'] by the css/variables-with-dark-theme format's generalized isDarkOverride (any color.<category>.dark.*).

error-text.comment: Lighter red for WCAG AA on tinted error-bg + dark page (#1a1a1a).

success-text.comment: Lighter green for WCAG AA on tinted success-bg + dark page.

info-text.comment: Lighter cyan for WCAG AA on tinted info-bg + dark page.

warning-text.comment: Lighter amber for WCAG AA on tinted warning-bg + dark page.

neutral-text.comment: Lighter neutral for WCAG AA on tinted neutral-bg + dark page.

focus-ring.$comment: Gap 8 — focus-ring color + width. WCAG 2.4.7 focus-visible target; contrast ratio vs both light and dark surfaces >= 3:1.

color.comment: Blue-500-ish; brighter than accent-300 for high visibility

control.comment: Dark-theme control rest boundary. The light-theme value is darkened to clear 3:1 on a near-white page; in dark the original #cccccc already measures 7.87:1 against the --surface-elevated fill, 10.84:1 against the page and 8.94:1 against the card, so it is kept rather than moved. system_3 task #4061.

mono.value: Iosevka, "Iosevka Web", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.comment: Mono stack — Iosevka-first (same self-hosted webfont as font.family.base; Iosevka is monospace so base and mono resolve to the same face).

motion.$comment: Gap 4 — motion primitives. Durations already live in transition.* (base.json); ease curves are added here and prefers-reduced-motion is handled at consumer level (no dedicated token — see tokens/README.md).

breakpoint.$comment: Gap 5 — breakpoint tokens. Mobile-first — treat as min-widths.

z-index.$comment: Gap 6 — z-index scale. Replaces magic numbers 1000/1001 currently in the sidebar (aspirant-client/src/components/*Sidebar*).

focus.comment: 2px solid ring around focus target — pairs with color.focus-ring.width + offset
